Working as a procurement & contracts specialist you will be responsible for providing end-to-end sourcing, contracting & contract administration across Tier 13 contractor packages & capital project procurement. During the planning pre-award phases, you will execute RFI/RFQ/RFP processes, manage prequalification and evaluation activities, lead commercial negotiations & prepare recommendations for award. You will draft, negotiate & execute contracts, statements of work & variations, while ensuring compliance with procurement policies and governance requirements. Your role will involve validating daily & weekly cost reporting (CWSR/CDSR), managing variations and emergent works, tracking KPIs  supporting corrective actions where required. You will maintain procurement dashboards, progress trackers & contribute to finance & project controls reporting. At close-out, you will support final invoicing, performance reviews, SAP close-out actions & ensure all records are archived in line with governance standards. The role requires close collaboration with senior procurement leaders, turnaround managers, HSE, legal, finance & external contractors to ensure safe & commercially sound project delivery. Min 5+ years experience in procurement & contract administration within turnarounds, shutdowns, mining, chemicals or heavy industry Proven end-to-end sourcing experience (RFI/RFQ/RFP), evaluation management & commercial negotiation
Strong contract drafting, execution & administration experience, including variations, emergent scope & KPI management
Experience working with SAP (P2P) & strong MS Office/Excel capability; Strong understanding of governance, procurement policies & compliance frameworks; Ability to manage multiple stakeholder relationships across HSE, IR/ER, Legal, Finance & Project Controls; Willingness to travel to Phosphate Hill & Mount Isa sites & work execution rosters, incl weekends where required

Kodi Construction Group Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based construction company currently seeking a qualified and experienced Carpenter to join our team on a full-time basis.

Location: Queensland, Australia (Brisbane, Logan, Gold Coast and surrounding areas)

This is a genuine full-time position required for the ongoing operations of the business.

Position Overview:
We are looking for a skilled Carpenter to perform a wide range of construction and carpentry tasks across residential and small commercial projects. The role requires a high level of workmanship, reliability, and the ability to work both independently and within a team.

Key Responsibilities:
- Construct, install and repair structures and fixtures made from timber and other materials
- Measure, cut, shape and assemble materials according to plans and specifications
- Interpret technical drawings and building plans
- Install decking, framing, pergolas, roofing structures and general carpentry works
- Ensure all work complies with Australian building standards and regulations
- Maintain tools and equipment in safe working condition
- Follow all Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) requirements
- Work efficiently to meet project deadlines

Requirements:
- Certificate III in Carpentry (or equivalent qualification)
- Minimum 2 years relevant work experience
- Ability to read and interpret plans
- White Card (mandatory)
- Driver’s licence and reliable transport
- Strong attention to detail and quality workmanship
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Specialised Industrial Solutions (SIS) is a locally owned and operated industrial services company based in Mount Isa, servicing mining and industrial clients throughout Queensland and the Northern Territory.
Our fleet supports mining, industrial cleaning, maintenance and transport operations throughout regional and remote Australia. We are seeking experienced Truck Drivers to support our growing operations.

Desirable

Working at Heights.

Safely operate HC/MC heavy vehicles throughout Queensland and the Northern Territory.
Transport equipment, machinery and materials to mine and industrial sites.

Monitor vehicle condition and arrange routine servicing and maintenance as required.

Complete transport and compliance documentation.
Assist with mobilisation and demobilisation of equipment.
Maintain vehicles in a clean and serviceable condition.
Comply with all site safety, environmental and operational procedures.

Benefits
Full-time permanent employment.

Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
Diverse work across mining, industrial and transport projects.
Travel and accommodation provided for remote project work.

result.description: Boram Tiling Pty Ltd   Construction Estimator    Boram Tiling Pty Ltd    Position: Full-time, permanent (38 hours per week)       Salary: $90,000 - $95,000 base salary + Superannuation    Location: Strathfield NSW 2135    About the Role   We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our pre-construction team on a permanent full-time basis. The successful applicant will play a key role in preparing accurate cost estimates and competitive tenders for commercial and residential construction projects, with a particular focus on tiling and waterproofing trade packages.  Reporting to the Director, you will work closely with project managers, suppliers, subcontractors and clients to ensure accurate pricing and successful tender submissions.   How to apply   Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant construction estimating experience and suitability for the role. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities    Prepare detailed cost estimates and quantity take-offs for commercial and residential construction projects, particularly tiling and waterproofing trade packages.  Analyse project conditions, trade scopes, installation requirements and site factors to determine labour, material, equipment and preliminary costs.  Measure quantities and prepare material take-offs using estimating software such as Bluebeam and Cubit Estimating.  Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings, specifications and contract documentation.  Liaise with builders, suppliers, subcontractors and internal project teams to obtain quotations and technical information.  Conduct site inspections where required to verify measurements, access conditions and installation requirements.
